arxiv-2108-13701.title: Quantum outage probability for time-varying quantum channels
arxiv-2108-13701.creator: Josu Etxezarreta Martinez 1,∗ , Patricio Fuentes 1 , Pedro Crespo 1 and Javier Garcia-Frias 2
arxiv-2108-13701.description: Abstract Recent experimental studies have shown that the relaxation time, T 1 T_{1} , and the dephasing time, T 2 T_{2} , of superconducting qubits fluctuate considerably over time. Time-varying quantum channel (TVQC) models have been proposed in order to consider the time varying nature of the parameters that define qubit decoherence.

arxiv-2209-14799.title: Random cubic planar maps
arxiv-2209-14799.creator: Michael Drmota, Marc Noy, Clément Requilé, Juanjo Rué
arxiv-2209-14799.description: Abstract We analyse uniform random cubic rooted planar maps and obtain limiting distributions for several parameters of interest. From the enumerative point of view, we present a unified approach for the enumeration of several classes of cubic planar maps, which allow us to recover known results in a more general and transparent way.

arxiv-2212-02143.title: Impact of Domain-Adapted Multilingual Neural Machine Translation in the Medical Domain Thanks: Citation : Work presented at Translating and the Computer - TC44, 24 November 2022, Luxembourg. https://asling.org/tc44/confirmed-presentations/#Rios-Gaona
arxiv-2212-02143.creator: Miguel Rios, Raluca-Maria Chereji, Alina Secară, Drago s , Ciobanu
arxiv-2212-02143.description: Abstract Multilingual Neural Machine Translation (MNMT) models leverage many language pairs during training to improve translation quality for low-resource languages by transferring knowledge from high-resource languages. We study the quality of a domain-adapted MNMT model in the medical domain for English-Romanian with automatic metrics and a human error typology annotation which includes terminology-specific error categories.

arxiv-2310-16783.title: S 3 -TTA: Scale-Style Selection for Test-Time Augmentation in Biomedical Image Segmentation
arxiv-2310-16783.creator: Kangxian Xie \sthanks The first author performed work during research internship at Boston College, Siyu Huang, Sebastian Cajas Ordonez, Hanspeter Pfister, Donglai Wei
arxiv-2310-16783.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Kangxian Xie \sthanks The first author performed work during research internship at Boston College, Siyu Huang, Sebastian Cajas Ordonez, Hanspeter Pfister, Donglai Wei. Deep-learning models have been successful in biomedical image segmentation. To generalize for real-world deployment, test-time augmentation (TTA) methods are often used to transform the test image into different versions that are hopefully closer to the training domain. Unfortunately, due to the vast diversity of instance scale and image styles, many augmented test images produce undesirable results, thus lowering the overall performance.

arxiv-2406-01275.title: Lifting Factor Graphs with Some Unknown Factors
arxiv-2406-01275.creator: Malte Luttermann, Ralf Möller, Marcel Gehrke
arxiv-2406-01275.description: Abstract Lifting exploits symmetries in probabilistic graphical models by using a representative for indistinguishable objects, allowing to carry out query answering more efficiently while maintaining exact answers. In this paper, we investigate how lifting enables us to perform probabilistic inference for factor graphs containing factors whose potentials are unknown.

arxiv-2406-16925.title: Analyzing Multi-Head Attention on Trojan BERT Models
arxiv-2406-16925.creator: Jingwei Wang
arxiv-2406-16925.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jingwei Wang. 1 Introduction Trojan attack can make the model achieve the state-of-the-art prediction on clean input, however, perform abnormally on inputs with predefined triggers, the attacked model is called trojan model . Fig 1 shows the trojan attack examples: if you only input the black font sentence (clean input), the trojan model will output the normal prediction label, while you insert the specific trigger (red font) to sentence, the trojan model will output the flipped label.

arxiv-2502-19154.title: Towards Privacy-Preserving Anomaly-Based Intrusion Detection in Energy Communities
arxiv-2502-19154.creator: Zeeshan Afzal, Giovanni Gaggero, Mikael Asplund
arxiv-2502-19154.description: Abstract Energy communities consist of decentralized energy production, storage, consumption, and distribution and are gaining traction in modern power systems. However, these communities may increase the vulnerability of the grid to cyber threats. We propose an anomaly-based intrusion detection system to enhance the security of energy communities.

arxiv-2506-17080.title: Tower+ : Bridging Generality and Translation Specialization in Multilingual LLMs
arxiv-2506-17080.creator: Ricardo Rei, Nuno M. Guerreiro, José Pombal, João Alves, Pedro Teixeirinha, Amin Farajian, André F. T. Martins
arxiv-2506-17080.description: Abstract Fine-tuning pretrained LLMs has been shown to be an effective strategy for reaching state-of-the-art performance on specific tasks like machine translation. However, this process of adaptation often implies sacrificing general-purpose capabilities, such as conversational reasoning and instruction-following, hampering the utility of the system in real-world applications that require a mixture of skills.

pmc-10573684.title: Left Atrial Posterior Wall Isolation with Pulsed Field Ablation in Persistent Atrial Fibrillation
pmc-10573684.creator: Melanie A Gunawardene, Gerrit Frommeyer, Christian Ellermann, Mario Jularic, Patrick Leitz, Jens Hartmann, Philipp Sebastian Lange, Omar Anwar, Benjamin Rath, Rahin Wahedi, Lars Eckardt, Stephan Willems, Carlo Rostagno
pmc-10573684.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Background: Left atrial posterior wall isolation (LAPWI) may improve rhythm control in addition to pulmonary vein isolation (PVI) in persistent atrial fibrillation (persAF) patients undergoing catheter ablation (CA). However, LAPWI may be challenging when using thermal energy sources. Objective: This study aimed to investigate the efficacy and safety of LAPWI performed by non-thermal pulsed field ablation (PFA) in CA for persAF. Methods: Consecutive persAF patients from two German centers were prospectively enrolled.

pmc-11642895.creator: Joana Neiva, Zohra Benzarti, Sandra Carvalho, Susana Devesa
pmc-11642895.description: This study investigates the structural, chemical, and morphological properties of CuO nanoparticles synthesized via a green synthesis route using Opuntia ficus-indica cladode extract, with a focus on the effects of stepwise versus direct calcination. Raman spectroscopy revealed the presence of CuO, Na2CO3, and Na2SO3, with the latter two being associated with elements inherited from the cactus extracts.

pmc-13381855.description: Aortic aneurysm and dissection (AAD) are high-risk cardiovascular diseases with limited preventive pharmacotherapies based on angiotensin II receptor blockade. uslaw-usc-t22-s3009.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t22-s3009.description: United States Code, Title 22 (Foreign Relations And Intercourse); Chapter 45 (Commission On Security And Cooperation In Europe). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. For purposes of costs relating to printing and binding, including the costs of personnel detailed from the Government Publishing Office, the Commission shall be deemed to be a committee of the Congress.
